_comment: 26.9.0 is WINDOWS ONLY -- no macos block, so Mac users are told an update exists but get no in-app download and are pointed at the notes page instead. release_url/notes_url point at the PUBLIC notes page on this host, not at the GitHub release: the app repo is private, so a release URL 404s for every tester and for anyone signed out. Since 2026-08-14 publish-feed.sh defaults both fields to this notes page, so they no longer need correcting by hand (earlier notes saying otherwise are stale); it also refuses to run when the tag disagrees with spool-ui/Cargo.toml. NOTE: publish-feed.sh does NOT carry this _comment forward -- re-add it by hand after regenerating, or the next person loses this explanation. Windows is self-signed (real Authenticode + timestamp) so SmartScreen still warns.
